Instagram पर एशिया का असली किंग कौन है, इसका खुलासा हो चुका है और हमारे इंडियन स्टार्स ने तो पूरी दुनिया में झंडे गाड़ दिए हैं! 🔥

Marketing Mind की 2026 एशिया-वाइड रैंकिंग रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, क्रिकेट सुपरस्टार Virat Kohli पूरे एशिया में सबसे ज्यादा फॉलो किए जाने वाले पर्सनालिटी बनकर नंबर 1 पर हैं। इस लिस्ट में Prime Minister Narendra Modi दूसरे और BLACKPINK की Lisa तीसरे नंबर पर हैं। 👑

बॉलीवुड हसीनाओं की बात करें तो Shraddha Kapoor लगभग 94-94.7 million फॉलोअर्स के साथ सबसे आगे हैं। उनके बाद Priyanka Chopra Jonas लगभग 92-94.3 million और Alia Bhatt 85-86.7 million फॉलोअर्स के साथ टॉप लिस्ट में शामिल हैं। 📸

Deepika Padukone के पास 80.3-80.4 million और Katrina Kaif के पास 78.2-80.2 million फॉलोअर्स हैं, जो हाल ही में Vogue India के 2026 कवर पर 8 साल बाद दिखाई दी थीं। वहीं Priyanka Chopra Jonas ने अपने बिजनेस को बढ़ाते हुए Gymkhana Fine Foods में भी इन्वेस्ट किया है। ✨

इनके अलावा Neha Kakkar, Salman Khan, Jacqueline Fernandez, Urvashi Rautela और Akshay Kumar जैसे स्टार्स भी इस पॉपुलर लिस्ट का हिस्सा बने हैं। 🌟

क्या आपका फेवरेट बॉलीवुड या क्रिकेट स्टार इस टॉप लिस्ट में शामिल है, कमेंट्स में नाम लिखकर बताओ? 👇

ctx.text:
Virat Kohli, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Shraddha Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Katrina Kaif have featured among the most-followed Indian personalities on Instagram in 2026, joining several global names in the latest Asia-wide social media ranking highlighted by Marketing Mind. The list brings together personalities from cricket, politics, Bollywood and the international music industry, reflecting their reach across digital platforms.
Virat Kohli leads the Asia-wide ranking as the most-followed personality, followed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and BLACKPINK's Lisa. Priyanka Chopra Jonas is among the highest-placed Indian celebrities on the list, while Shraddha Kapoor and Alia Bhatt also feature among the leading Bollywood names. Katrina Kaif rounds off the top 10 of the reported Asia-wide list with approximately 78.6 million followers. Other international personalities featured include BLACKPINK members Jennie, Rosé and Jisoo.
Among Bollywood celebrities, Shraddha Kapoor has one of the largest Instagram followings, with approximately 94–94.7 million followers. Priyanka Chopra Jonas follows with an estimated 92–94.3 million followers, while Alia Bhatt has approximately 85–86.7 million. Deepika Padukone is also among the leading Indian film personalities with around 80.3–80.4 million followers. Katrina Kaif has an estimated following of 78.2–80.2 million.
A post shared by Marketing Mind (@marketingmind.in)
The list of widely followed Indian entertainment personalities also includes singers and actors such as Neha Kakkar, Salman Khan, Jacqueline Fernandez, Urvashi Rautela and Akshay Kumar. Their Instagram audiences highlight the popularity of Indian entertainment figures across different sections of the industry.
For Priyanka Chopra Jonas, her presence in the ranking reflects her continued international visibility as an actor, entrepreneur and investor. She recently expanded her business portfolio by investing in Gymkhana Fine Foods, a home-dining brand inspired by London's two-Michelin-starred Indian restaurant Gymkhana. The venture aims to bring the restaurant's signature flavours to home kitchens worldwide.
Meanwhile, Katrina Kaif's inclusion comes after her appearance on the cover of Vogue India's November–December 2026 issue, marking her first cover story for the magazine in eight years. Styled by Rhea Kapoor in custom outfits by Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla, the cover feature explored her journey as an actor, entrepreneur and mother.
Sharing the Asia-wide ranking, Marketing Mind wrote: “From cricket stadiums and Bollywood screens to global music charts, some of Asia’s biggest names have built massive audiences on Instagram… Featuring cricket legends, global leaders, Bollywood icons and K-pop superstars, the list reflects their massive reach and popularity across social media.”
The rankings offer a snapshot of the digital following commanded by leading personalities from India and across Asia. From Virat Kohli's cricket following to the international audiences of Priyanka Chopra Jonas and the popularity of Bollywood stars such as Shraddha Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Katrina Kaif, the list reflects the varied reach of Indian personalities on Instagram.
